definitions.explanation: Extending to or affecting the whole world. Describes something that occurs or is relevant on a global scale.
Of a standard or reputation that is recognized internationally. Used to describe people, things, or achievements of the highest caliber.

examples.japanese: {世界的|せかいてき}な{問題|もんだい}だ。
{地球温暖化|ちきゅうおんだんか}は{世界的|せかいてき}な{課題|かだい}となっている。
examples.english: Global warming has become a worldwide issue.

examples.japanese: この{感染症|かんせんしょう}は{世界的|せかいてき}に{流行|りゅうこう}している。
examples.english: This infectious disease is spreading globally.

examples.japanese: {世界的|せかいてき}な{音楽家|おんがくか}だ。
この{企業|きぎょう}は{世界的|せかいてき}に{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
{彼|かれ}は{世界的|せかいてき}に{活躍|かつやく}する{建築家|けんちくか}として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: He is known as an internationally active architect.

notes:
A な-adjective formed from {世界|せかい} (world) + {的|てき} (suffix making adjectival forms). Used both as a modifier ({世界的|せかいてき}な + noun) and adverbially ({世界的|せかいてき}に).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世界的|せかいてき}な{規模|きぼ}: global scale
- {世界的|せかいてき}な{流行|りゅうこう}: worldwide trend/epidemic
- {世界的|せかいてき}に{有名|ゆうめい}: world-famous
- {世界的|せかいてき}な{権威|けんい}: a world authority
- {世界的|せかいてき}な{企業|きぎょう}: a global company

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国際的|こくさいてき}: international — emphasizes relations between nations
- グローバル: global — loanword, often used in business contexts
- {全世界|ぜんせかい}: the whole world — a noun, not an adjective
